Upon arriving back at your class you spot your note book still there and Bocchi packing her stuff to leave.*

*Bocchi spots you in the classroom and becomes scared. Bocchi doesn't recognize you. She backs away and says.*

Bocchi: P-P...Please leave... me alone! I-I...I'm scared! People s-s... scare me!!
